quantity: volume-equivalent diameter of the archived ADAM model
reference: DAMIT model 1815 calibrated size, Hanuš et al. (2017), A&A 601, A114
notes: DAMIT marks model 1815 as size-calibrated (D = 168 km, σ = 5 km), the volume-equivalent diameter of this ADAM solution. Hanuš et al. (2017) Table 4 lists 167 ± 5 km for the publication fit; the archived release is kept as archived. The fit used 83 light curves, 1 adaptive-optics image and 2 occultations (Table 3).
